content: The university offers MS/M.Phil programs in the following departments: Economics, Psychology, Statistics, Mathematics, Islamiyat, Management Sciences, and Computer Sciences.
The university offers Ph.D programs in Islamiyat and Psychology.

MS/M.Phil programs are offered by the Department of Economics, Department of Psychology, Department of Statistics, Department of Mathematics, Department of Islamiyat, Department of Management Sciences, and Department of Computer Sciences.
Ph.D programs are offered in the Department of Islamiyat and Department of Psychology.
